addressInvariant: Fleet.makeNode is called with [dc.prefix, cell, W33-point], and dcId is the id of that same dc object.
energyBecomesMeaningfulAt: cross-cell or cross-datacenter candidate selection where full fabric addresses, not only W33 point digits, are available
supersedesInterpretation: The 36.20% reduction in data/near_ovoid_secondary_costs.json is a declared synthetic point-to-site sensitivity experiment. It must not be read as an actual level-1 seeded-fleet energy saving.
reading: In Holotrade's actual fleet address model, topology-aware within-cell migration and site-energy optimization live at different routing levels.
boundary: Catalog energy numbers remain prototype seed data; this is a software-addressing invariant, not live telemetry or a physical energy theorem.
